test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following practices is least harmful in the conservation of forests and wildlife?

options.text: Using forests as a source of raw material for industries
Building roads and dams in forested areas

solution:
The correct answer is __**Collecting non-timber forest produce.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Non-timber forest produce** (NTFP) refers to** goods and services** that are obtained from forests other than timber.
 
• These include **fruits, nuts, honey, medicinal plants, **and other resources that can be** harvested sustainably **without damaging the forest ecosystem.
 
• Collecting NTFP can provide livelihoods for local communities and reduce their dependence on unsustainable activities such as** logging and poaching.**
 
• This can help to** conserve forests and wildlife **in the long term.
 
• Unlike other activities such as building roads and dams, collecting NTFP **does not require **major infrastructure development that can have negative impacts on the environment and local communities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Using forests as a source of** raw material **for industries can lead to** overexploitation **of forest resources and contribute to **climate change** through emissions from processing and transportation of wood products.
 
• Converting forests to** plantations,** especially** monoculture** plantations, can have negative impacts on biodiversity, soil fertility, water availability, and local livelihoods.
 
• **Agroforestry and mixed-species plantations** can be more sustainable alternatives.
 
• Building** roads and dams** in forested areas can fragment habitats, facilitate** illegal activities **such as hunting and logging, and **displace local communities.**
 
• Proper environmental** impact assessments and community consultations **are necessary to minimize these impacts.
